programme.title: The Hunted
programme.desc: As Wendy Darling (Rachel Hurd-Wood) recounts stories to her brothers, John (Harry Newell) and Michael (Freddie Popplewell), she is visited by Peter Pan (Jeremy Sumpter). Peter, a boy who magically never ages, invites Wendy and her brothers to Neverland, an island where he lives with the Lost Boys. Once there, however, Wendy and her brothers are kidnapped by Captain Hook (Jason Isaacs). Peter, with assistance from the fairy Tink (Ludivine Sagnier), must face Hook in order to rescue the Darlings.

programme.title: The Munsters
programme.desc: This iconic horror film follows the obsessed scientist Dr. Henry Frankenstein as he attempts to create life by assembling a creature from body parts of the deceased. Aided by his loyal misshapen assistant, Fritz, Frankenstein succeeds in animating his monster, but it escapes into the countryside and begins to wreak havoc. Frankenstein searches for the elusive being and eventually must confront his tormented creation.

programme.title: US Open Pickleball Championships 2025
programme.desc: The stakes reach their absolute peak at Mumbai’s Jio World Garden for the first semifinal of the World Pickleball League Season 2, where there are "no do overs" for the Chennai Super Champs and Pune United. Witness a high-stakes tactical chess match as Chennai’s coach Jonny Goldberg makes the bold move to start premier player Rika Fujiwara against the "big and aggressive" Katie Morris in a critical women's singles clash. The intensity continues with a masterclass in mixed doubles featuring the powerful pairing of Lee Hwang Nam and Carlota Trevino facing off against Pune's consistent stars, William Sobeck and Magdalena Gregorio. Every point is a desperate grind for survival as these two titans battle through "world class" rallies for a guaranteed spot in the grand finale.

Frankenstein searches for the elusive being and eventually must confront his tormented creation.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Lidia grew up around goats, who loved to play and run, but also produced the most delicious milk which would then be used to make ricotta. Here she makes light and pillowy "Naked" Spinach and Ricotta Dumplings. She then prepares an easy, sweet Open Cookie Cannoli. Finally, her Ricotta Meatloaf is topped with tomato sauce to give it some Italian flair.

Here she makes light and pillowy "Naked" Spinach and Ricotta Dumplings. She then prepares an easy, sweet Open Cookie Cannoli. Finally, her Ricotta Meatloaf is topped with tomato sauce to give it some Italian flair.

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Si hay algo que la malvada hechicera Clorhidris no puede soportar es la felicidad de las demás personas. Contemplar la vida de los Pitufos, llena de amabilidad y canciones, pone furiosa a Clorhidris. Debe destruir esas risas y ahogar esas felices conversaciones… Entonces, planta la raíz del mal en el bosque y, poco después, todos los Pitufos dejan de hablarse. El único que no se ha visto afectado es Bebé Pitufo…

programme.title: Steel Frontier
programme.desc: Early in the 21st century, technological advances have made it possible for aging, wealthy people to pay crooks like Vacendak (Mick Jagger) to go back in time, kidnap young victims like race car driver Alex Furlong (Emilio Estevez) and deliver them to the elderly clients, who then have their brains transplanted into the healthy bodies. Furlong manages to break free from his captors, but as a fugitive, he finds that the world of the future is a bleak, dangerous place.

programme.title: Chine, Les maitres de l’Art
programme.desc: A comedian and actor, Jonathan Lambert has a passion for art, and is the author of a photo-novel, "Qui a volé mes jambes?" (Who stole my legs?), a tribute to the surrealist painter Pierre Molinier. He is also curator of the exhibition "A Hundred Years of Chess", presented at the Perrotin Gallery in Paris. Pauline Guerrier is a cosmopolitan and well-travelled artist. Her sculptures and tapestries are inspired by her encounters with craftspeople from Benin to India. Claire Tabouret's drawings at the Grand Palais and her stained-glass windows at Notre-Dame are in the Vizorek'xpert chronicle. A look back at the theft of a Rembrandt, with Reza Pounewatchy.

(Who stole my legs?), a tribute to the surrealist painter Pierre Molinier. He is also curator of the exhibition "A Hundred Years of Chess", presented at the Perrotin Gallery in Paris. Pauline Guerrier is a cosmopolitan and well-travelled artist. Her sculptures and tapestries are inspired by her encounters with craftspeople from Benin to India. Claire Tabouret's drawings at the Grand Palais and her stained-glass windows at Notre-Dame are in the Vizorek'xpert chronicle. A look back at the theft of a Rembrandt, with Reza Pounewatchy.

programme.desc: Ah Fu (Wang Tao) and Chen Ting Kuan (Carter Wong) are a couple of kung fu men in the escort service business with top notch kung fu styles. Ah Fu gets tired of the escort service and quits and takes up the life of a normal man. In his new "life", Ah Fu runs into a thief named Li Chi (Li Kun), and the two become the best of friends. Life is great! Ah Fu gets married to a pretty girl, Yu Lan (Ha Ling Ling). He has money, servants, and foot massages. What else could you want?
